_about: Arthur Ransome (1884-1967), the Swallows and Amazons series. Ransome died in 1967, so in life+70 countries (the UK, the EU) none of the twelve books is public domain until 1 January 2038. In the United States a book published 1927-1977 is protected for 95 years from publication, so each book enters the US public domain on 1 January of its publication year + 96. Only book 1, Swallows and Amazons (Cape, August 1930), is US public domain today (since 2026-01-01); it is held here, flagged US-only. Books 2-12 are listed under _excluded with the date each becomes US public domain. Original text by the author, not a translation.

ransome-swallows-and-amazons-1930: Swallows and Amazons (London: Jonathan Cape; first published August 1930; this scan is the twenty-third impression, February 1946, of the new illustrated edition)

_rights_checked.ransome-swallows-and-amazons-1930: Title page read 2026-10-10: 'London - JONATHAN CAPE - Toronto. FIRST PUBLISHED AUGUST 1930. NEW ILLUSTRATED EDITION 1931 ... TWENTY-THIRD IMPRESSION FEBRUARY 1946', 'Illustrated by the Author'. The text is Ransome's 1930 book, US public domain since 2026-01-01 (published 1930, 95-year term). US ONLY: Ransome died 1967, so it is under copyright in the UK and other life+70 countries until 2038. Two caveats awaiting Adam (DIGEST-B): this is a later printing and the text has not been collated against a 1930 copy; and Ransome's own drawings, whose captions may appear in the OCR, date from the 1938 edition, so those captions are not yet US public domain. Stated by hand because the gate is fail-closed at 1930.
